about: Golden vectors for the composition sync manifest. valid: build the canonical bytes from `manifest`; UTF-8 encoding `canonical` gives those bytes and `manifest_sha256` is their SHA-256. invalid: validating `manifest` fails with `error.code` (and `error.rule` for path-policy rules). limits: with `limits`, the first exceeded limit in the order file_count, file_size, project_size, manifest_size is `limit` (null: admitted). stored: base64 `body` is stored manifest bytes; reading them requires they are already canonical.

valid.name: project-source
valid.description: Authored source and config, including project.json, lockfiles and AGENTS.md.

valid.name: input-order-ignored
valid.description: The same files as project-source in a different order produce the same canonical bytes.

valid.name: utf8-byte-order
valid.description: Files sort by UTF-8 bytes: U+E000 sorts before U+1F600 although UTF-16 code-unit order puts the emoji first.

valid.name: portable-hidden-and-media
valid.description: Completed .media assets with unused alternatives, .media/index.md, the named portable .hyperframes files, and hidden authored files.

valid.name: podcast-prepared-media
valid.description: Desktop's podcast transcodes under .hyperframes/prepared-assets/podcast/ travel, because the page plays them by that path.

valid.name: root-only-exclusions-below-the-root
valid.description: dist/, coverage/, remotion-src/, moments/ and references/moments/ are left out only at the project root; build/ and outputs/ travel, and a .media ledger name elsewhere is an ordinary file.

valid.name: reused-content-and-empty-file
valid.description: Two paths may share content; an empty file has size 0.

valid.name: allowed-punctuation
valid.description: Punctuation other than the forbidden characters is portable.

valid.name: length-boundaries
valid.description: A 240-byte segment and a 1,024-byte path are at the limit, not over it.

valid.name: largest-safe-size
valid.description: Sizes up to 2^53 - 1 are valid manifests; the push size limits are checked separately.
